:::{#exm-coin-nats}
#### One fair coin toss in nats

By @exm-surprisal-coins with $k = 1$, one toss of a fair coin landing heads
has a [surprisal](#def-surprisal) of $1$ [bit](#def-bit).
In [nats](#def-nat), the same [outcome](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-experiment-outcome) has a surprisal of

$$
\begin{aligned}
\surprisalf{\text{heads}}
&= -\ln \tfrac{1}{2} \\
&= \ln 2 \\
&\approx 0.693 \text{ nats}.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
